Discounts for Uninsured Patients- If you are paying for your own care, you may be eligible for a self-pay prompt pay discount. In order for a discount to be considered, your charge estimates must be paid in advance, and any billed amount must be paid timely.  Accounts that are in collections are not eligible for a discount. Your Patient Business Services customer services staff is available to review your account and advise you about any potential discounts.  Consistent with CMS payment methodology, Anesthesia pricing is dependent on base unit charge, time, acuity, age, and other conditional factors.  The pharmacy pricing is based on the package size of the medication. The final calculated price varies based on several factors including dose ordered, patient age, patient weight, and cost of the medication.  Typical Stem Cell Transplant (SCT) case rate payments are intended to cover the transplant period defined by beginning and end dates, starting with mobilization regimen and ending with certain number of days following discharge from transplant.  Due to the ability for payors to pay higher rates and patient circumstances related to premature case closings, covered services, storage of stem cells, timing of radiation and/or chemotherapy and emerging drugs and technologies, SCT rates include case payments and other Percent of Total Billed Charges per case.
